ImmunePrep (oncology immunotherapy adjunct platform) — concept / early development stage.
ChemoPrep (chemotherapy delivery optimization) — concept / early development stage.
ChemoPure (chemotherapy detoxification) — concept / early development stage.
CardioDialysis (MACE-reduction blood purification) — concept / early development stage.
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Pre-clinical-stage device therapeutics company. Lead asset Sigyn Therapy is a Class III blood-purification device that has completed in vitro and animal studies; an IDE has been drafted for submission to FDA but no IDE has been cleared and no first-in-human study has commenced. All other assets (ImmunePrep, ChemoPrep, ChemoPure, CardioDialysis) are at concept/early-development stage. No active P1/P2/P3 clinical trials.
